MC.noise_model: Poisson(original-raw fitted expected_e) + Gaussian read noise, ADC round/clamp to DN
MC.expected_source: fit of the same original raw; plug-in, not independent measurement
MC.interval_method: baseline +/- normal quantile * MC sample sigma; approximate, no bias correction
MC.empirical_nominal_coverage: not assessed; external nominal validation only
MC.budget: 8 repeats recommended, 16 maximum; fixed mother subset chosen outside callback
limitations: small finite MC sample; sample sigma is itself noisy
plug-in mean and calibration/model errors can bias uncertainty
nominal interval coverage requires separate externally scored validation
normal approximate signed interval does not impose template positivity
callback must rerun continuum and signed solver for every repeat
